name: Juhe
description: Juhe (fengshuiroom.com) turns classic yin-yang spatial wisdom into a practical web product. Homeowners and renters capture a room layout—by uploading a floor plan or drawing furniture on a canvas—then receive form-school scores for command position, backing, door rush, pathways, and clutter, plus an ordered checklist of fixes. It is not a near-me consultant booking desk and not temple mysticism. Start with Free Home Check; unlock full reports and layout compares with one-time credit packs.
